ModMetaData.name: Rim-MCP
ModMetaData.author: rakan
ModMetaData.description:
Rim-MCP lets you connect your colony to your favourite MCP-supporting AI agent.
For the modern high-impact 10x engineer looking to utilize agentic AI to drive business value in their colony.
• Ask deep questions about your stockpiles, pawns, recipes, and loaded content (including mods!). • Dictate your schedule and work priorities through a client with voice support and have an agent apply them. • Have the latest & greatest LLM pick your pawns' apparel policies. • Many more possibilities!
Requirements • RimWorld 1.6. • An agentic AI client with support for local (stdio) MCP servers.
Tested with: Codex & OpenCode.
Setup 1. Enable Rim-MCP in your mod list and restart the game. 2. Go to Options > Mod settings > Rim-MCP and click Copy MCP config. 3. Add that config to your client's MCP settings, (Or paste the config to your agent and tell it to configure itself, who has time to edit tomls nowadays). 4. Turn on RimWorld's Run in background option so requests work while you're alt-tabbed.
Allow colony changes is on by default. Turn it off in mod settings for read-only access.
If your client uses a cloud model, it may send colony data to that provider. Your colony data could help shape the mind of future LLMs, what could possibly go wrong?
Source: https://github.com/rakanssh/rimcp | Bugs: https://github.com/rakanssh/rimcp/issues
